name: review-spec
description: Review a design specification in Specs/ against the actual codebase to find inaccuracies, potential issues, or things that need correction before implementation. Use when asked to: "review a spec", "check a spec for issues", "validate a spec", "find problems in a spec", "review the spec for [feature]", "audit a spec against the codebase", or any request to verify that a specification accurately reflects the current code and conventions.
